messages:
ashley: opened a docs PR to add a compact checklist + snippet set for rate limits, quota tiers, and dashboard mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5102

pavan: Nice. Can you include: curl, python-sdk, node fetch, and the exact PromQL we use for the tier panels? People always ask for that.

maria: Also add a tiny "What changed" paragraph so customers know why headers/tiers are being adjusted in this release (brief bullet: clearer tier semantics, reserve/burst distinction).

ashley: Will do. For PromQL I added: `sum by (tier_label) (increase(billing.tier_assigned[30d]))` plus a short explanation of how to map `tier_label` -> pricing.

kevin: FYI the billing team wants us to call out monthly vs daily aggregation impact on quota attribution. Suggest showing both `increase(...[1d])` and `[30d]` examples.

pavan: Good call. Also include a tiny note for Dedicated customers: "reserve is applied prior to burst; dashboards show reserve consumption under `reserve_used`". Tagging eng to verify metric name later.

ashley: Added the Dedicated note and used conservative phrasing: "metric names differ for Dedicated; see Dedicated metrics table" and I'll add a follow-up once eng confirms exact metric.

maria: Snippets look clean. One nit: recommend lowercased headers in curl/python examples to avoid proxies downcasing surprises.

ashley: Updated examples to `x-redwood-quota-tier` (lowercase) for curl/python/node. Snippet sample: `curl -H 'x-redwood-quota-tier: gold' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and Python: `client.request('/v1/generate', headers={'x-redwood-quota-tier': 'gold'})`.

kevin: Could you add a mini migration checklist at top with steps: 1) Pin SDK >=0.9.2, 2) Update header names, 3) Validate in staging, 4) Check billing dashboard mapping? That's been helpful in other guides.

ashley: Done. I also added a deprecation callout for legacy headers and linked to the SDK changelog.

docs-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-5102--docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/quick-checklist (expires in 7 days).

pavan: Quick review on staging now. The PromQL text could use a one-line plain-English explanation: what the query returns and how to interpret spikes. I added a suggestion in the PR comments.

maria: LGTM for docs copy. Once design uploads a small dashboard thumbnail I'll put it in a follow-up PR rather than block this merge.

kevin: Approving on behalf of billing, pending eng metric-name confirmation for Dedicated.

ashley: Thanks everyone 389 merging in 10m if no other comments. I'll follow up with a tiny PR that adds the Dedicated metric mapping and a short example of how tier changes affect cost-per-token in the billing playbook.
